description: This file defines an abstract class 'View' in the namespace 'SuiteCRM\Search\UI\MVC'. The class manages a Sugar_Smarty template object and provides methods for setting the template file, rendering the template, and other related functionalities. It serves as a base class for creating UI views within the SuiteCRM search framework.

classes.name: View
classes.description: An abstract base class for search framework UI views, managing Smarty templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the View with a specified template file and creates a new Sugar_Smarty instance.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: A placeholder method intended to be overridden for pre-rendering actions.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the assigned template file using the Smarty engine.

methods.name: getTemplateFile
methods.description: Returns the current template file path.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets the template file to be used for rendering.
